content.text:
The [lint job](https://github.com/jdx/mise/actions/runs/34002029296/job/101403018346) fails because installing mbx modifies `mise.lock`.

CI successfully installs mr-boxington 1.8.3 and verifies its GitHub artifact attestations. That adds this field to its Linux x64 lock entry:

```diff
 provenance = "github-attestations"
+provenance_verified = true
```

The subsequent check rejects any dirty working tree and reports **“`mise run render` produced changes.”** That message is misleading here: the only diff is installation verification metadata, not generated documentation.

Committing the verified lockfile change would address this failure. The broader CI fix is to distinguish installation-induced lockfile changes from render output.

I’ll add the verified lockfile field and check the diff.
